mapper.select: SELECT v.*, COALESCE(c.category_code, 'OTHER') category_code FROM tb_variable_version v LEFT JOIN tb_variable_category c ON c.variable_code = v.variable_code AND c.isactive = 1 WHERE v.variable_code = #{variableCode} AND v.isactive = 1 ORDER BY v.version_number DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT v.*, COALESCE(c.category_code, 'OTHER') category_code FROM tb_variable_version v LEFT JOIN tb_variable_category c ON c.variable_code = v.variable_code AND c.isactive = 1 WHERE v.id = #{id} AND v.isactive = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_variable_category SET category_code = #{categoryCode} WHERE variable_code = #{variableCode} AND isactive = 1
